messages:
Alex (SE): quick update — adjusted POC plan for ArgoFin. TL;DR: staggered rollout, keep core NLU + embeddings, delay CSV import feature to post-trial. Need infra owner confirmation and a Dedicated slot hold for the peak test window.

Priya (Product): ok noted. Success criteria still: 95% intent accuracy on test set + <200ms median gen latency, correct?

Alex (SE): yes — that's the baseline. Also we need embedding recall >= 0.88 for the search flows.

Jamie (Eng-Platform): infra ask: can we get a 72h reserved pool starting 2026-04-05? if so, we can run scale test and perf runs. cc @Marta for SE test plan.

Marta (Solutions): I can own the test harness. plan: night-run 1 (warm KV cache) -> 1000 concurrent clients for 30m -> collect p95/p99. I'll post the harness recipe later. Need a cert/access for their staging S3.

Sean (SRE): S3 access OK, just need their VPC peering info and IP allowlist. If they want cross-account role, we need policy document.

Alex (SE): @Jamie can you hold the Dedicated slot tentative? I'll coordinate contracts. If not possible, fallback to Hosted + autoscale but may break latency SLO.

Jamie (Eng-Platform): tentative hold created — resource id: dedicated-argo-042. Putting a 48h soft hold. Please confirm by EOD Fri or it will auto-release.

Marta (Solutions): testing checklist (short):
- creds and S3 access confirmed
- small seed dataset loaded (5k docs)
- embed/recall smoke test (script attached)
- perf harness + load profile (night-run 1)

Alex (SE): script snippet for smoke embed test:
```bash
python tools/embed_check.py --host https://api.redwood.test --key $REDWOOD_KEY --sample 100
```

Priya (Product): timeline proposal:
- 2026-04-01: infra/oauth details + IP allowlist due
- 2026-04-05: reserved pool live, dry-run
- 2026-04-06: perf runs + evals
- 2026-04-09: final review and go/no-go

Sean (SRE): adding note: we'll need to rotate the test key after run. also will generate a minimal IAM policy and paste here shortly.

Alex (SE): owners summary:
- Program lead: Alex
- Test harness & evals: Marta
- Dedicated resource: Jamie
- Network/IAM: Sean
- Product acceptance: Priya

deploy-bot: Reservation tentative created: dedicated-argo-042 (owner: jamie). Auto-release 48h if not confirmed.

Marta (Solutions): I'll try to upload the harness and a small README tonight. tagging @Priya for acceptance criteria verification. :thumbsup:

Alex (SE): perfect — I'll chase legal for the minor contract addendum today. will update thread with any blockers.

Jamie (Eng-Platform): once you confirm, I'll flip the hold to confirmed and set the pool to 4 x A100. If we need quantized variants for cost, we can toggle during runs.

Priya (Product): thanks team. if anyone hits a blocker, drop it here and flag severity.
